info.title: Azure Log Analytics Fetcher
info.description: Fetches and filters AKS application logs from Azure Log Analytics.

post.summary: Fetch application logs from Azure Log Analytics
post.description: Searches a Log Analytics table for entries matching a filter pattern within a time range. Use this for errors, warnings, failed requests, timeouts, pod issues, and other application events.

parameters.name: filter_pattern
parameters.description: The search pattern to filter logs. Examples: ERROR, 503, timeout, connection refused, OutOfMemory, Unauthorized, Failed.

parameters.name: log_table
parameters.description: The Log Analytics table to query. Common AKS tables include ContainerLog, ContainerLogV2, KubePodInventory, and AzureDiagnostics.

parameters.name: hours_back
parameters.description: How many hours back to search. Use 1 for recent issues, 6 for trends, and 24 for daily patterns.
